title: MCIA Tribunal Rejects Rs 908 Crore Claim Against Tata Chemicals, Orders Rs 1 Crore Counter-Payment
case_name: Allied Silica Limited & Anr. v. Tata Chemicals Limited
card_summary: A three-member MCIA tribunal has unanimously rejected a Rs 908 crore claim by Allied Silica and its promoter against Tata Chemicals over a 2018 business transfer agreement. By majority, it still directed Tata Chemicals to pay about Rs 1 crore with interest and costs, a direction the dissenting member rejected. Allied Silica's earlier attempts before the NCLT, NCLAT and Supreme Court had all failed.
card_tip: Dismissal of the headline claim is not a clean sweep: a tribunal can reject the bulk of a demand yet still order a modest payment on a narrower head, so read the full operative part before calling a result one-sided.
verification_notes: Confirmed via Tata Chemicals' own Regulation 30 stock exchange filing (primary source) dated 16 October 2026 disclosing the MCIA tribunal's final award dated 15 October 2026, cross-checked against independent coverage in Indian Chemical News, Business Today and PSU Connect, all reporting the same figures, the 2-1 split on the counter-payment, and the prior failed NCLT/NCLAT/Supreme Court challenges by Allied Silica.
